sentences.en: The scene of the car accident was a horrifying sight.
sentences.zh: 这起车祸现场真是令人恐惧的一幕。

sentences.en: Fadil started to hear horrifying sounds coming from his room.
sentences.zh: 法蒂尔开始听到他房间里传来令人惊骇的声音。

sentences.en: The debate has been interesting, confusing, and sometimes horrifying.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论很有趣，也很让人困惑，有时甚至令人震惊。

senses.zh: 使恐惧；惊骇；使极度厌恶

mnemonic: 词根记忆：horr（害怕）+ify（使…）→使恐惧
